title: decode.rs b64_input_was_limited detection is fragile and hard to follow
description: decode.rs lines 65-72: b64_input_was_limited is set based on 'stripped.len() == max_b64_chars && max_b64_chars < usize::MAX && body_bytes.iter().filter(...).nth(max_b64_chars).is_some()'. The nth() call rescans body_bytes from scratch (O(n) second scan) and the logic is hard to reason about. A comment explaining the intent (detect that base64 input was truncated before all content was consumed) would help. Also the is_truncated logic in step 2 (lines 112-125) has three arms that are non-obvious to read in sequence. A single function returning (decoded_bytes, is_truncated) would be clearer.
